content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notification invites applications for Visiting Faculty positions in the School of Mathematics and Statistics to teach Mathematics and Statistics subjects at graduate and post-graduate levels. The exact total number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

rows.qualification: Master’s degree in Mathematics/Applied Mathematics/Statistics/Applied Statistics with a minimum of 55% marks or an equivalent Grade, AND a Ph. D degree in Mathematics/Statistics OR NET conducted by UGC or equivalent qualification like SLET /SET accredited by the UGC. The candidate should not have any ATKT in his/her career from graduation onwards. The selection committee can relax these conditions for candidates with computer skills and experience such as C++, python, latex and with other numerical skills.
rows.experience: Teaching experience of teaching mathematics/statistics to the graduate and post graduate students of Mathematics/statistics will be given added advantage. Research paper publication in peer reviewed Journals and in National/International conferences will be the desirable qualifications but not mandatory.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Selected candidates shall be paid an honorarium of Rs. 800/- per hour or Rs. 400/-per hour or Rs 200/- per hour as per candidate’s qualification and university norms. The candidate must be ready to take both theory and practical class and invigilation duties as required. Ph.D pursuing candidates must attach NOC from their supervisor saying that He/she has no objection being her/his student employed as a visiting faculty in the department. Candidates willing to be paid as per university rules and regulations need to apply. The candidate with interests to teach any subjects at the graduate level and commitment in teaching the complete semester need to apply only.

content_sections.heading: DAVV Visiting Faculty Job Description
content_sections.text: Teach Mathematics and Statistics subjects at graduate and post graduate levels. Take both theory and practical class. Perform invigilation duties as required.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DAVV Visiting Faculty
content_sections.text: Obtain the application form in the prescribed format. Fill out the application form with personal details, educational qualifications, professional qualifications, teaching experience, papers published/workshops attended, and computer professional skills. Attach self-attested copies of professional qualifications and an NOC from the supervisor if pursuing a Ph.D. Submit the application form in person between 11.00 AM-5.00 PM to the HOD, School of Mathematics and Statistics, Vigyan Bhawan, Khandwa Road Indore (MP) 452001. Ensure the application is submitted on or before 15 NOVEMBER 2026. Online submission of the application will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Application form in the prescribed format Self-attested copies of professional qualifications (UGC NET/MP-SET/GATE/Any other) NOC from supervisor (for Ph.D pursuing candidates) Publication reprints (publication without reprints will not be considered)

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Last date for submission is 15 NOVEMBER 2026. Online submission of the application will not be accepted. Application details without the prescribed format will not be considered. Selection will be done through a personal Interview at School of Mathematics and Statistics; no request of online interview or change of interview date will be entertained. No TA /DA will be given to candidates for attending the interview. Candidates shortlisted for interview will be intimated individually.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DAVV Visiting Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form in person is 15 NOVEMBER 2026 between 11.00 AM-5.00 PM.

faq.answer: Applicants need a Master’s degree in Mathematics/Applied Mathematics/Statistics/Applied Statistics with a minimum of 55% marks or an equivalent Grade, along with a Ph.
